visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and a small earring is seated inside a moving Tuk Tuk at night. He is wearing a light-colored button-up shirt over a white tee, with a black DJI microphone clipped to his collar. He looks around with a concerned facial expression as a yellow car passes by his vehicle. The scene is heavily saturated with blue neon lighting from the vehicle's interior. (2) The camera angle shifts to a POV shot looking out from the Tuk Tuk onto a busy, multi-lane city road at night. Numerous cars with glowing red taillights and bright headlights are visible against a backdrop of distant urban buildings and traffic lights. (3) Back to the man, he is now laughing and smiling broadly, exhibiting high emotional arousal. He grips a silver metal handle of the vehicle tightly with his left hand as the Tuk Tuk accelerates. The background shows blurred greenery and street lights passing by rapidly, indicating high speed. (4) The man continues to laugh and look up towards the roof of the vehicle, his hair blowing in the wind. The blue lighting remains consistent. He appears both thrilled and slightly overwhelmed by the speed. (5) The vehicle slows down or stops. The man is seen stepping out of the Tuk Tuk in a darker outdoor environment. He carries a black textured bag with pins on it. He looks directly at the camera and speaks with a calmer, reflective expression. (6) A final graphic screen appears with a dark purple and blue aesthetic. It features profile information, social media icons, and a large central image of the man looking exhausted or frightened with text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a fast-paced electronic dance music track featuring a prominent kick drum and bright synth stabs. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a slightly anxious pitch, reacting to the traffic environment. Wind rushing and a low-frequency engine hum are audible in the background. (2) A sharp percussive 'hit' sound effect marks a transition. The male voice shouts excitedly, 'It's over! He's going to speed!', followed by loud, high-pitched laughter. The music remains at a high energy level with constant rhythmic pulses. (3) The intensity of the wind noise increases, suggesting high-speed movement. The speaker continues to vocalize excitement and fear with a wide pitch range. A quick 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut. (4) The BGM continues steadily as the male voice comments on the speed with clear articulation but high emotional energy. The ambient traffic noise is layered beneath the speech and music. (5) As the vehicle presumably stops, the wind noise drops significantly. The male voice shifts to a lower arousal state, speaking more conversationally with a friendly and relieved tone. The sound of fabric rustling is heard as he moves. (6) The video ends with the music fading out or reaching a short rhythmic resolution, accompanied by a final narrative sentence from the speaker.
